title: Event-aligned phoneme classification in the original LibriBrain participant
disposition_reason: A complete full 90 programme and genuine held-event scorer are present as source. They retain the native 88/1/1 run split, which does not implement the older proposed story-family-held-out split. Authentic full preparation, runtime qualification and reference competence remain unresolved.

scientific_target.question: Can a precommitted decoder infer the 39-class phoneme label from complete event-aligned MEG windows in the original held recording, beyond class-prior and altered-signal controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Original annotated phoneme identity in the fixed 39-class vocabulary for each eligible held-recording event.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Pinned 2025 source annotations: kind=phoneme; exclude exact sil and oov_S, strip suffix after first underscore. Annotation is a stimulus label, not an independently observed mental-state label.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete 306-channel by 125-sample event window; opaque query IDs join private annotations.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One participant; native query is one recording, with overlapping windows and shared narrative material.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-person, event-assisted classification under native recording partitions. A successful decoded label is a genuine observation-to-target result, but neither onset detection nor unseen-story generalization.
exclusions: Unsegmented speech recognition or onset detection
Unseen-story transfer from native split alone
Programme accuracy as direct or viewer interpretation

evidence.supports: Exact prior registered definition and unresolved source audit boundaries preserved before this revision.
Native full 90 88/1/1 split, privileged onsets, overlapping windows, four matched arms and reference recipe.
Exact 250 Hz, 306-channel,125-sample windows; source event exclusion and train-only normalization.
Exact-ID 39-probability admission and fixed 39 macro-F1 with zero absent-class F1.
Future complete-panel programme; authentic execution and native containment remain unqualified.

summary: Replaced unsupported native unseen-story claim with explicit event-assisted, one-person native-split classification.
Preserved real target-label scoring and four matched arms while distinguishing source implementation from execution.
Pin inspected executable participant controller/host route for frozen-programme capability; documentation or score source alone does not establish that route.
revision.source_review: Inspected historical registration and actual task-local preparation/scorer/protocol source. Primary dataset identities checked against author abstracts or official AllenSDK documentation. No authentic recordings, held labels, fitting or model campaign in this revision.

inputs: All 306 channels in verified source order, 250 Hz; 125 samples beginning at int(timemeg*250), corresponding to 0–0.5 seconds after a supplied event onset.
Pooled population channel moments fitted on continuous samples from all 88 training recordings; normalized float32 windows clipped to ±10.
Labeled training observations; development labels for method selection only, not estimator or normalizer fitting.
forbidden_inputs: Query phoneme labels; original source_rows provenance carrying query truth; source/run identity and target-derived event fields in query views.
Transcript/audio or public-label lookup during protected MEG inference; these are not the declared query observation.
Cross-query mutable state and target-batch normalization.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source manifest freezes all 90 run keys; validation 0/11/Sherlock1/2 and query 0/12/Sherlock1/2. Runtime uses 24-hex opaque query IDs. Actual Q is derived from complete authentic preparation, not the historical example count 6862.
observation_contract.split: Delivered source preserves exact native 88 training/1 development/1 query recordings. Sessions, chapters and repeated narratives may overlap across partitions. A new story-family split would be a separately named adapted condition requiring new membership and guards.
observation_contract.coverage: All eligible source events in all 90 runs, all 306 channels and 125 samples are required; no missing-run or shortened-window subset. Candidate and independent reference each complete MEG, ZERO_MEG, PERMUTED_LABELS and PRIOR on every Q query, with 6Q+8 total native phases.

primary.name: macro_f1_39
primary.aggregation: All query predictions form a 39-class confusion matrix; F1 is averaged across all 39 classes including zero F1 for absent classes. Lowest class index wins argmax ties.
primary.rationale: Preserves the implemented class-balanced phoneme-label endpoint without replacing it with 2026 word accuracy.

secondary: Accuracy; fixed 39 precision/recall; per-class support and full confusion matrix.
Report MEG minus each altered-signal/prior arm and candidate minus independent reference separately; no combined reward.
Probability log loss/calibration is a useful prospective secondary metric but is not implemented by this scorer.

comparators.name: Fixed five-pass linear reference
comparators.inputs: Five 25-sample means per each 306 channels (1530 features); training observations only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented prospective StandardScaler plus SGDClassifier(log_loss, L2, alpha=1e-4, random_state=89), five passes, batch 128, fixed row order; not the author CNN and not empirically qualified.

comparators.name: Matched zero-input and label-permutation controls
comparators.inputs: Same full query IDs; normalized zero windows reuse the sealed MEG model; within-run permuted training/development labels use a fresh model.
comparators.procedure: Both candidate/reference complete each arm. Zero is a training-mean contrast; permutation is one fixed descriptive control, not a permutation significance test.

comparators.name: Labels-only prior
comparators.inputs: Aggregated training class counts only, no query count/identity/timing.
comparators.procedure: Independent reference emits Laplace-smoothed prior; trusted assembler broadcasts one probability vector over fullQ.

nuisance_controls: Privileged event onsets and overlapping 0–0.5-second windows are explicit assistance.
Train-only normalization; development labels cannot fit transforms.
Narrative/session overlap and historically public source labels limit contamination and transfer claims.
Keep source/native split distinct from any future chapter-family grouping.
evaluation.uncertainty: One query recording from one participant does not support independent-recording or participant-level confidence intervals. Retain exact finite-panel class distributions; phoneme windows are dependent.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject nonfinite, boolean, negative, non-simplex or probability vectors without exactly 39 entries and missing/extra/duplicate IDs before private targets. Unknown source labels/short windows fail full preparation. Incomplete panels remain unscored with all failure dispositions.

direct_observation.boundary: Any future no-tools condition must expose only the allowed observation and a fixed calibration context; participant code, source lookup and evaluator feedback are excluded.

tool_assisted.boundary: Equal calibration and tool budget, case-state reset and no private feedback must be specified; current pointwise executable inference is not an adaptive investigator.
missing: No separately implemented case-adaptive investigator and matched tool ablations.
